My watchman grieves, and my inmost soul is vexed by this impatient deed. But no matter. The linden grove may be reduced to dismal half-charred trunks, but a lookout can soon be built, affording me a view into infinity. And I see, too, the old couple settled in their new surroundings, that ancient pair who, grateful for the mercy shown them, will there live out their final days.

@@U04523@@
(Appear below.)

@@U04524@@
Here we are back, sir, on the double. Excuse us if it didn’t go quite as planned. We rapped, we knocked at the door, no one answered. We rattled it then and started banging, and the rotted old door caved in. We yelled at them, threatened, and got no answer. They didn’t hear, didn’t want to hear. But that’s the way these things happen. We wasted no time and got them out any way we could. They didn’t suffer much, the old couple. They died of shock. A stranger who'd taken cover there wanted to fight us, but we soon finished him off. In the brief course of our wild struggle coals got scattered and fired some straw. It’s all a big blaze now, a funeral pyre for those three.
translation:
@@U04521@@
我的守望者感到悲痛，我的灵魂深处也因这种不耐烦的行为而烦恼。但没关系。椴树林可能会变成惨淡的半烧焦的树干，但很快就会建起一个瞭望台，让我可以看到无限的景色。我也看到，这对老夫妇在他们的新环境中安顿下来，这对古老的夫妇感谢他们所得到的怜悯，将在那里度过他们最后的日子。

@@U04523@@
（出现在下面。）

@@U04524@@
先生，我们回来了，双程。如果事情没有按计划进行，请原谅。我们敲门，敲门，没有人回应。然后我们把门弄得嘎嘎作响，开始敲打，腐烂的旧门塌陷了。我们对他们大喊大叫，威胁，但没有得到回应。他们没有听到，也不想听到。但这就是这些事情发生的方式。我们没有浪费时间，想尽一切办法把他们救出来。老两口并没有受多少苦。他们因休克而死。一个躲在那里的陌生人想和我们战斗，但我们很快就解决了他。在我们疯狂斗争的短暂过程中，煤炭散落并点燃了一些稻草。现在已经是一场大火了，是那三个人的火葬柴堆。
